title: Beyond Accuracy: Dissecting Mathematical Reasoning for LLMs Under Reinforcement Learning

layout.note: A white left card with the two-stage recipe, a middle dashed grid of four tinted hint cards under a bold title, and a bar chart at the right; a pink wedge points from card 1 into the left card and three coloured wedges point from cards 2 to 4 into the chart.

lesson: Draw a menu of variants as numbered, colour-coded cards that each hold the same tiny scene (question, hint, answer), and tie the colours to the result chart with wedge arrows and legend circles so the finding reads without a table.
